title: TerraFlux ocean circulation run request v1 (input of terraflux-run-ocean-circulation)

sponge.description: Relaxation strength ramps linearly from 1 at the wall to 0 over the given rows.

timestep_seconds.description: Must satisfy the gravity-wave CFL bound, f dt <= 0.5, r dt <= 1 and the explicit viscous bound.

spinup_steps.description: Unrecorded steps; the gyres need the Rossby-wave crossing time (years) to establish.

basin.description: Water where the terrain lies at or below sea level, or an explicit mask; optional sponge rows as an open-boundary proxy.

height_m.description: Tall ridges above sea level are continents; negative heights carve trenches.

linear_friction_s.description: Rayleigh drag r; the Stommel boundary-layer width is r / beta.

formation_reduced_gravity_m_s2.description: Surface water with g' below this sinks (deep-water formation).

mixed_layer_depth_m.description: Surface layer holding the freshwater content; surface salinity = S (1 - F / h_mix).

stream_speed_threshold_m_s.description: Connected cells faster than this (2 or more) are streams.

heat_capacity_j_kg_k.description: Sea-water heat capacity for the heat budget and the surface fluxes.

lens_salinity_deficit_psu.description: Surface lens: the surface is fresher than the layer by at least this.

thermal_layers.description: Layered temperature and salinity column: sigma layers of the active layer (geometric, top layer surface_layer_m at the initial thickness), two-band shortwave penetration, convective adjustment, Kraus-Turner wind mixing, bulk-Richardson shear mixing and implicit diffusion.

wind_mixing_efficiency.description: m0 of the Kraus-Turner energy budget m0 rho_0 u*^3 dt.

bulk_richardson_number.description: Critical bulk Richardson number of the shear mixing (Price, Weller & Pinkel 1986); 0 disables it.

initial_thermocline_scale_m.description: T(z) = T_deep + (T_s - T_deep) exp(-max(0, z - mld) / scale).

initial_surface_temperature.description: uniform: ocean.initial_temperature_k at the surface; surface_temperature_target: the forcing target of the first interval.

lens_memory_s.description: e-folding memory of the fresh water each sea cell received, for attributing surface lenses.

sea_ice.description: Sea ice (zero-layer Semtner thermodynamics with a concentration): needs thermal_layers and forcing.air_sea. The covered fraction takes the ocean-ice heat flux and has its own surface energy balance; open water below the freezing point forms frazil; freezing rejects brine (ice keeps ice_salinity_psu), melt returns fresh water; ice shelters the water from the wind stress. The ice drifts freely with the upper-ocean current plus a share of the wind (Nansen), is carried upwind between sea cells (coasts are walls) and ridges where it converges, up to maximum_ridge_thickness_m.

initial_band_k.description: Initial ice where the top layer is within this band above its freezing point.

new_ice_thickness_m.description: Thickness of new ice over open water (lead closing); at least minimum_thickness_m.

wind_drift_factor.description: Ice speed from the wind as a share of the 10 m wind speed.

wind_turning_deg.description: Turning of the wind drift to the right of the wind in the northern hemisphere (left in the southern).

maximum_ridge_thickness_m.description: Ice stops moving into a cell at the maximum concentration that is at least this thick (a stand-in for the ice strength free drift lacks).

oneOf.description: tau_x = -tau_0 cos(gyres pi y'/L') with y' measured from south_margin_m; one gyre = subtropical only, two = subtropical + subpolar.

interpolation.description: Sampling of the coupled frames in time.

oneOf.description: Wind stress rho_air C_d |U| U and the surface temperature target from a coupled-wind timeline sampled at the nearest cell.

cold_patches.description: Gaussian cold (or warm) patches blended into the linear profile: deep-water formation sites.

net_precipitation.description: P - E, linear in north; negative = net evaporation (salt stays, water leaves).

east_m.description: The mouth is the nearest water cell.

events.description: Additional discharge during the events (meltwater pulses, floods).

catchment_timeline_path.description: A catchment hydrology timeline; its ocean + edge outflow rate between frames, times catchment_scale, is added to the discharge (piecewise constant, held after the last frame).

chemistry.description: River water chemistry (needs biogeochemistry): nitrate, dissolved inorganic carbon, total alkalinity and O2 as a share of saturation.

air_sea.description: Bulk air-sea exchange: evaporation (Dalton), sensible (Stanton), longwave (Berliand), shortwave (Zillman clear sky, Reed cloud), solved implicitly at the surface. The air is the surface-temperature target + offset + diurnal cycle + air masses, or a coupled-wind timeline; the wind speed is the 10 m wind equivalent to the stress.

diurnal_amplitude_k.description: Air temperature cycle peaking at 15 h local solar time.

rain_saturates_air.description: Analytic air only: under rain above 0.1 mm/h the air is at least 95 % humid and 90 % cloudy. A coupled atmosphere keeps its own humidity and cloud.

solar_constant_w_m2.description: Top-of-atmosphere irradiance of the astronomical shortwave.

solar_cycle_path.description: A terraflux-run-solar-cycle timeline (or a terraflux.solar.forcing/v1 file), relative to the working directory: its annual TSI is applied as an anomaly, 1361 W/m2 + TSI(t) - its mean TSI, at each step's date (the mean Sun outside its years). Excludes solar_constant_w_m2.

air_masses.description: Moving Gaussian anomalies of air temperature and humidity (e.g. a cold, dry outbreak).

coupled_timeline_path.description: Air temperature, humidity, pressure, cloud fraction, wind and storm wind speed from a coupled-wind timeline.

interpolation.description: Sampling of the coupled frames in time.

seasonal_amplitude_south_k.description: Annual air temperature cycle (warmest on day 196), linear from south to north; analytic air only.

rain.description: Rain on the sea (fresh water at its own temperature into the surface) and on land (coastal land drains to the nearest sea cell through a linear reservoir). Needs events and/or a coupled timeline.

radius_m.description: Gaussian footprint; omit for uniform rain.

coupled_timeline_path.description: Cell-mean precipitation (rate x duration_fraction) plus orographic precipitation, with the wet-bulb temperature, from a coupled-wind timeline.

interpolation.description: Sampling of the coupled frames in time.

temperature_offset_k.description: Without air-sea exchange: rain at the surface-temperature target plus this.

band_m.description: Land within this distance of the sea drains directly to it; 0 = off.

warming.description: Climate warming: dT = min(max_k, rate (t - start)) x amplification (linear from south to north), added to the surface-temperature target and the analytic air. Off during the spin-up (t counts from the start of the main run).

hosing.description: Meltwater hosing: F = min(max_sv, ramp (t - start)) until end_seconds, then down at the same ramp, of fresh water at 0 degC spread evenly over the sea cells within the circle (glacial meltwater of the budgets).

end_seconds.description: After this time the hosing ramps down at the same rate to zero (default: never).

ice_sheet.description: A coupled land ice sheet (shallow-ice flow, positive-degree-day surface mass balance, ocean-driven frontal melt): lives on the land cells of the region (bed = terrain), is driven by the air-sea air temperature lapse-rated to its surface and by the ocean thermal forcing at front_depth_m; its meltwater enters the nearest sea cells as liquid at 0 degC, its icebergs and frontal melt as ice that takes latent heat from the top layer. Needs thermal_layers and forcing.air_sea.

initial_dome.description: Elliptical (Vialov-like) initial dome; centre and radii default to the region.

precipitation_m_we_yr.description: Snowfall at the reference air temperature.

precipitation_per_k.description: Relative increase of snowfall per kelvin (Clausius-Clapeyron-like).

front_depth_m.description: Depth at which the ocean thermal forcing of the fronts is read.

step_every.description: The ice sheet steps once every this many ocean steps.

marine_front_fraction.description: Share of the margin cells that end in the sea (tidewater) and melt at the front.

biogeochemistry.description: Ocean carbon, oxygen and nitrate on z-levels down to the seafloor (DIC, alkalinity, O2, NO3): transport with the current, rivers, mixing, air-sea CO2/O2 exchange, production, export and respiration, ventilation; habitability (hypoxic, anoxic, corrosive, metabolically stressed) and dead zones. Needs physics.thermal_layers, forcing.air_sea and atmosphere_co2.

levels_m.description: Increasing depths of the level bottoms (m).

minimum_depth_m.description: Seafloor depth floor for shallow sea cells.

surface_dic_from_atmosphere.description: Start the surface DIC in equilibrium with the air.

dic.description: value(z) = deep + (surface - deep) exp(-z / scale_m), umol/kg.

alkalinity.description: value(z) = deep + (surface - deep) exp(-z / scale_m), umol/kg.

oxygen.description: value(z) = deep + (surface - deep) exp(-z / scale_m), umol/kg.

nitrate.description: value(z) = deep + (surface - deep) exp(-z / scale_m), umol/kg.

river_chemistry.description: Default chemistry of rivers without their own.

atmosphere_co2.description: CO2 of the boundary-layer air over the region (ppm): the background of a scenario at the inflow and by ventilation, carried by the wind, raised by the sources, taken up by vegetation and by the ocean. Needs biogeochemistry.

background_ppm.description: [year, ppm] points with increasing years, interpolated linearly (held beyond the ends).

photosynthesis_umol_per_j.description: CO2 taken up per joule of photosynthetically active radiation.
